_note: Interest on a loan for a first house: an individual, "interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of acquisition of a residential house property" (s.130(1), p.165), "shall not exceed ₹ 50000" (s.130(2)); "(a) the loan has been sanctioned by the financial institution during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2016 and ending on the 31st March, 2017; (b) the amount of loan sanctioned … does not exceed thirty-five lakh rupees; (c) the value of residential house property does not exceed fifty lakh rupees; and (d) the assessee does not own any residential house property on the date of sanction of loan" (s.130(3), p.166) — "value" is undefined, entered as the house's value. ChapterEightNode tries this before DED-HOUSE-LOAN (s.131(1)). The same interest is not deductible under any other provision for the same or any other tax year (s.130(4)) — house-property interest under s.22(1)(b) must leave it out (W-078). rulebook DED-80EE-001, DED-80EX-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80EE, is unread (W-075d). D-139.
